name: progressive-student-dashboard
description: Full-stack app tracking student progress across courses with analytics dashboards.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "PORT=4000 npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.render-build: npm run install:all && npm --prefix server run db:generate && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build && rm -rf server/public && cp -r client/dist server/public
